target.description: Target hostname or IP address to trace; required argument.

max_parallel_flows.description: Maximum number of parallel flows (positive integer).

src_port.description: Source UDP port for probes (positive integer, recommended range 1024–65535).

dst_port.description: Destination UDP port for probes (positive integer, recommended range 1–65535).

probe_size.description: Size of probe packets in bytes (minimum 28 for valid ICMP replies).

num_probes.description: Number of probe packets per hop (positive integer).

timeout.description: Timeout per probe in milliseconds (positive integer).

delay.description: Delay between probes in milliseconds (non-negative integer).

icmp_errors.description: Enable parsing and use of ICMP error messages.

use_tcp.description: Use TCP SYN packets instead of UDP.

use_icmp.description: Use ICMP ECHO packets instead of UDP.

df_bit.description: Set the Don't Fragment bit in IPv4 header (Linux only).

no_random_payload.description: Disable randomization of probe payload data.

payload_hop.description: Additional hop distance in bytes between successive probe payloads (0–255).
